taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: NoSQL operator and query injection — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect accepted input types, JSON decoding, selector construction and the actual database query API. Separate intended advanced-query capability from ordinary scalar fields.
controls.controlled_verification: In a local dataset compare a valid scalar filter with a caller-supplied structured value at the exact affected field. Observe the final selector/operator interpretation and selected synthetic records. Follow validation through wrappers or JSON re-decoding to establish whether the database receives the structure.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An operator-looking string stored as a literal is not query control. Rejecting an object at schema validation defeats that path. A user-authorized query console needs its own capability contract.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the intended scalar/structured schema and construct trusted selectors explicitly. Retest valid scalar queries, wrong types and the original operator path without removing intended search functionality.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
